Inspect and explicitly download optional reference data

lexdiv_resources.Rd

Lists fixed reference-data versions and their separate terms, or downloads selected resources after an explicit acknowledgement. Installing the package and ordinary calculations never download reference data.

Usage

lexdiv_resource_info(resources = c("tubelex", "nj8", "morpholex", "bnccoca", "morphynet"), cache_dir = NULL)
lexdiv_download_resources(resources, accept_license = FALSE, cache_dir = NULL)

Arguments

resources

Unique resource names as a plain character vector. The inspection default lists all resources; downloading always requires an explicit selection.

accept_license

Exactly TRUE after reviewing each resource's license_url and notice_url. Defaults to FALSE, which refuses downloads.

cache_dir

One directory path. Defaults to option ldfreq.resource_dir, then environment variable LDFREQ_RESOURCE_DIR, then tools::R_user_dir("ldfreq", "cache"). Set the same option or environment variable when reading resources stored outside the default cache.

Value

A data frame with resource name, fixed version, license and notice URLs, download bytes, verified availability, cache path, archive URL, SHA-256 and citation. The downloader returns it invisibly.

Details

Archives are downloaded from a fixed release and checked for byte count, SHA-256, expected member names and individual file hashes before installation. A verified cache is reused without a download. An incomplete or modified cache produces an error; it is not silently replaced. To repair one, explicitly remove only the version directory reported by lexdiv_resource_info() and rerun the download. Other resource versions remain separate.

MorphoLex is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (noncommercial); BNC/COCA is CC BY-SA 4.0; MorphyNet is CC BY-SA 3.0; TUBELEX is BSD-3-Clause; NJ8 has its own permission and attribution terms. These datasets are not included in the MIT package. The MorphyNet resource is a nine-row example, not the full database.

No resource is needed for the core diversity metrics. Resource-specific readers explain the required download if a cache is missing. Copying a verified cache to an offline machine is supported; use the same cache setting there. Unused caches may be removed explicitly by the user.

Examples

lexdiv_resource_info()[c("resource", "license", "available", "download_bytes")]
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Review the source, license_url and notice_url before downloading.
lexdiv_download_resources("tubelex", accept_license = TRUE)
lexdiv_resource_info("tubelex")
} # }
